title: Wait without blocking
summary: FastAPI: Wait without blocking. Return 6 from read_score.
introduction: An async route can await an async operation. GET /score waits for a completed coroutine and returns its result.

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Wait without blocking
blocks.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Query, HTTPException, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
app = FastAPI()
async def read_score():
    return 8
@app.get("/score")
async def score():
    value = await read_score()
    return {"score": value}

blocks.text: await obtains 8 from the coroutine. The returned dictionary then exposes it as score.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not put blocking work in async routes and assume async makes it faster.
